boundsAndCleanup.cleanup: Release/drain and reap exact ps child before returning to unchanged Runner guard. Exception paths close pipes and perform bounded exact waits. Group cleanup and leader reap remain separate and unverified cleanup fails coverage.
boundsAndCleanup.limit: This sequence does not reproduce signalling a still-live setuid ps in group cleanup. Uninterruptible/denied cleanup cannot be guaranteed; its failure is not represented as success.
boundsAndCleanup.output: Counts/discards chunks; outer capture occurs only within its cap. No synthetic stdout is published.

controlsAndScope.drainingControl: Same synthetic command with normal pipe drain.
controlsAndScope.fixedHarnessControl: Separate pinned native census preflight; four harness hashes and actual Mac unreaped-child guard retained.
controlsAndScope.historicalCause: UNKNOWN: new controlled-child evidence cannot identify the old denied generation or original native browser exit.
controlsAndScope.synthetic: 16384 repeated PID fields plus intentionally undrained stdout differ from actual native harness command and normal capture_output consumption.

ownershipAndGeneration.bsd: Full BSD is supplemental and may remain permission-denied/unknown. Any obtained identity must be live and match parent/group before and after the query; available birth tags must all agree. Unknown BSD never establishes measured counters.
ownershipAndGeneration.outerGroup: Bounded PID/PGID inventory must contain the helper exact Popen PID in the monitor group. Worker target has a separate session/PGID; outer proof does not use post-exit getpgid.
ownershipAndGeneration.primary: A dedicated worker retains one exact unreaped Popen ps child. Each of three target reads is bracketed by sequence-matched worker WNOWAIT acknowledgments; all six must report same exact child, no reaping wait/poll, no pending exit, matching child and errno zero.

waitidABI.mandatoryMacGate: Pipe-gated live child, two exit-pending non-reaping observations, exact exit7 reap, then ECHILD; guard failure stops before experiment.
